title: Molecular engineering and electrolyte optimization strategies for enhanced performance of Ru(II) polypyridyl-sensitized DSSCs
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9763-9786
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01470K, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Islam M. Abdellah
This review highlights the advantages of optimizing various DSSC components, such as Ru(II)-polypyridyl photosensitizers, co-adsorbents, electrolytes, electrolyte additives, and counter electrodes, to improve the overall performance of DSSCs.
